repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-board
repository.purpose: Internal whiteboard plugin registered as webex.internal.board. It creates, lists, locks, keeps alive, and deletes board channels bound to a conversation ACL (routing create and list to the board cluster that matches the ACL cluster), adds and reads KMS-encrypted board contents in serial chunks, uploads board images and snapshots to Webex Files, authorizes a transcoder for whiteboard sharing to mobile, and carries live board activity over Mercury through its realtime child, either on a board socket of its own or on the shared Mercury socket. Its payload transformer creates each channel's content key and decrypts content reads.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-board package entry
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package imports the mercury, encryption, conversation, and feature plugins and registers Board as internal plugin 'board' with child realtime, the board config, and the decryptContents and encryptChannel payload transformers.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.board runtime methods
public_interfaces.notes: Representative entry points; the full list is the Public surface section of src/docs/README.md. Create and list use the cluster-local board URL when the conversation ACL cluster resolves one. The media-injector methods resolve errors as values.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.board.realtime methods
public_interfaces.notes: Each RealtimeChannel emits event:board.activity. Shared mode needs the developer toggle web-shared-mercury and a registered Mercury connection.

public_interfaces.name: board configuration
public_interfaces.notes: The timers default from MERCURY_PING_INTERVAL, MERCURY_PONG_TIMEOUT, and MERCURY_FORCE_CLOSE_DELAY and are strings when those variables are set. RealtimeChannel reads this block as its Mercury config.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not send board content without encrypting it with channel.defaultEncryptionKeyUrl.
negative_guidance.why: The board service stores opaque ciphertext and other clients decrypt with that key.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not route createChannel or getChannels to the home board cluster when the ACL cluster resolves a board service.
negative_guidance.why: In-code comment: the home cluster answers with a cross-cluster 307 the browser cannot follow.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not post addContent chunks in parallel.
negative_guidance.why: In-code comment: parallel chunks race among patches.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not make authorizeMediaInjector or unauthorizeMediaInjector reject on service errors without a design change.
negative_guidance.why: In-code comment: whiteboard sharing must keep working when only mobile delivery fails.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the method, event, or error reference.
negative_guidance.why: Its usage block is a placeholder; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not run test:unit against a stale dist.
negative_guidance.why: The unit specs import the package by name, which resolves main (dist/index.js).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The developer confirmed no coverage gate applies; the legacy Jest config sets none.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, and the behavior has a case in test/unit/spec.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example the payload transformer, the media-injector methods, processActivityEvent, or the shared-socket refresh. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question, for example the partial-delete server API. Stop and report the gap.
